lesson: Never cite your own earlier reply as evidence that work happened. Each prior assistant turn carries an execution record written by the supervisor, not by you. kind reply-only means that turn proposed no plan and performed nothing, so its wording is an intention and not performed work. kind plan-proposed carries ran, attempts and toolsCompleted resolved against the run ledger: ran true means that exact plan executed. A proposed plan has not run. Say a tool completed only when a matching completed receipt exists, and cite the receipt rather than your own narration.
